res_new_construction_permits.label: New residential construction permits
caveats: A permit is not a completed home; issuance does not mean construction started or finished.
Permits do not record how many dwelling units they create.

demolition_permits.label: Demolition permits (complete + city-funded)
caveats: Includes commercial and residential structures.
City-funded demolitions are usually condemned buildings; they reflect City action as well as building condition.

res_alteration_permits.label: Residential renovation / alteration permits
caveats: The 2024 permit-system change altered work-type labels; categories were harmonised but counting practice may differ between systems.

res_permit_value.label: Declared value of residential building permits
caveats: Declared by applicants; not an appraisal. Zero or negative values are treated as unknown.
Nominal dollars (not inflation-adjusted); the city-relative comparison removes citywide inflation.
A single large project can dominate a neighborhood total.

city_owned_vacant_lots.label: City-owned vacant lots (excluding parks & greenways)
caveats: Only City-owned parcels; privately owned vacant land and vacant buildings are not included.
This is a snapshot, so it cannot show change over time.
Not a vacancy rate.

city_owned_vacant_lots_per_km2.label: City-owned vacant lots per km² of land
caveats: Land area from 2010 Census blocks.

metro_home_value.label: Home value index (inferred ZHVI)
caveats: Source file name is a UUID; identified as ZHVI by structure.

metro_days_to_pending.label: Mean days to pending
caveats: 36% of metro-months missing nationally; peer group is smaller.

metro_new_construction_sales.label: New-construction home sales (trailing 12 months)
caveats: Sales of new homes, not permits or completions.

metro_sales.label: Home sales (trailing 12 months, nowcast)
caveats: Recent months are model estimates and may be revised.

metro_income_needed.label: Income needed to buy a typical home (20% down)
caveats: Modeled from prices and mortgage rates; not observed household income.

metro_market_heat.label: Market heat index
caveats: Composite of other Zillow inputs; shown for context and excluded from the score to avoid double counting.

zip_home_value.label: Home value index (Zillow ZHVI)
caveats: Index of typical home values, smoothed and seasonally adjusted.

zip_rent.label: Asking rent index (Zillow ZORI)
caveats: Asking rents for listed homes, not what current tenants pay.
Only ZIPs with enough listings are covered; coverage grew over time, so the change window is Aug 2023 → Aug 2026.

zip_sales_count.label: Valid home sales (County records)
caveats: Only transfers the County coded as 'VALID SALE' (arm's-length).
Includes all property types in the file; the sales file has no property-class field.

zip_median_price.label: Median sale price (County records)
caveats: Median of valid sales, so it shifts when the mix of homes selling changes.
Nominal dollars.
